subject: Request: cryptographic key inventory + access logs for SIG/CAIQ
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@bluevalley.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluevalley.com
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Request: cryptographic key inventory + access logs for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Marissa,

Following up from our vendor intake — Blue Valley is working through SIG/CAIQ and we need a focused set of artifacts related to encryption and key management. Can you provide the following (or confirm what you can/ cannot provide) by EOD Friday, 2 weeks from today?

- Key inventory: all active key IDs (KMS/HSM), algorithm, creation date, origin (cloud KMS, customer-managed HSM, BYOK), and rotation policy
- Key rotation history: rotation dates for any keys with rotation enabled (last 12 months)
- Access logs: all principal actions (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, DescribeKey, CreateGrant, RevokeGrant) for the same 12-month window. CSV or JSON export is fine.
- HSM attestation: manufacturer certs or attestation report for any hardware security modules used
- In-transit encryption: short description of TLS/TCP encryption posture and any exceptions (mutual TLS, client certs)

Also let us know delivery preferences for logs (S3 presigned link, encrypted archive via secure transfer, or limited-access portal). We may request redacted logs for customer identifiers.

Please loop in your security contact. We can schedule a 30-minute call next week if helpful.

Thanks,

Alice Nguyen
Security Lead, Blue Valley Finance
alice.nguyen@bluevalley.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@bluevalley.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: cryptographic key inventory + access logs for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Neha from Security and Aditya (account lead).

Quick notes and plan:
- We can provide a key inventory export in CSV (I've attached a template so you can confirm fields we should include).
- Rotation history and key metadata available from KMS/HSM audit records; for customer-managed HSMs we'll include attestation references rather than raw key material.
- Access logs: we can produce CloudTrail-style exports for the requested APIs. We typically deliver a redacted CSV with principal ARNs replaced by unique tokens unless raw principals are required for audit purposes.
- HSM attestation: we can share vendor attestation PDFs and FIPS/TAA certs where applicable.

Proposed timeline:
- Inventory (template populated): 3 business days
- Rotation history + summary: 5 business days
- Full access log export + attestations: 10 business days (may require secure transfer approval)

Delivery methods: S3 presigned HTTPS link (preferred), or encrypted archive via our secure transfer if you prefer.

Please confirm redaction requirements and whether Blue Valley needs raw principal identifiers. We can also book a 30-minute call Monday/Tuesday to walk through the artifacts.

Attachments: redwood-kms-inventory-template.csv (attachment)

Best,

Marissa Cole
Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@bluevalley.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: cryptographic key inventory + access logs for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Alice — Neha from Redwood Security here. I wanted to add technical detail to Marissa's timeline so you have expectations for the deliverables. Below is what we can produce and the formats you'll receive.

1) Key inventory (CSV) — fields included: key_id, key_alias, key_origin (AWS-KMS | HSM | BYOK), key_type (symmetric|asymmetric), algorithm, created_at, last_rotated_at, rotation_policy (cron/auto/manual), owner_team, environment (prod/stage).

2) Rotation history — table exported as CSV with key_id, rotation_timestamp, rotated_by (redacted principal token or raw principal if requested), rotation_method (auto|manual). For HSM-managed keys rotation events reference HSM control-plane operations; these are correlated into the same CSV.

3) Access logs — we will export CloudTrail events for the requested APIs and present them as newline-delimited JSON and a summarized CSV. Sample lines: 
{
  "eventTime": "2026-09-15T12:23:45Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": "principal-xxxxx",
  "requestParameters": { ... }
}

We will replace customer identifiers with hashed tokens unless you explicitly request raw principals for an audit reconciliation.

4) HSM attestation & certs — attached: hsm-attestation-2026.pdf (manufacturer statement) and a list of firmware versions. Where we operate customer-managed HSMs, we will include the BYOK handshake record (no key material).

5) In-transit encryption — brief note on TLS: all connections to Redwood hosted endpoints use TLS1.2+ (we are deprecating TLS1.2 for public endpoints and require TLS1.3 for private connections by Q3 2027). Mutual TLS is supported for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted API uses bearer tokens + standard TLS.

Delivery options: presigned S3 (HTTPS), Transfer Appliance (for very large archives), or secure portal upload. Let us know an acceptable window for redaction review.

Estimated delivery: inventory CSV within 3 business days, initial log samples within 5 business days, full exports + attestations within 10 business days. If Blue Valley requires raw principal identities, allow +2 business days for the additional approvals.

Attachments: sample-cloudtrail-export.json, hsm-attestation-2026.pdf

If you want, we can provide a short walkthrough of the CSV schema on the kickoff call.

Regards,

Neha Kapoor
Senior InfoSec Engineer — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@bluevalley.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluevalley.com, purchasing@bluevalley.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: cryptographic key inventory + access logs for SIG/CAIQ

Thanks Marissa & Neha — that timeline works for us. A few quick items:

- Please proceed with the planned redaction (hashed principal tokens) for the initial delivery; we may follow up requesting raw principals for an audit reconciliation.
- Presigned S3 link is acceptable. We will provide a secure bucket to receive the exports if that simplifies rotation of access.
- Please include SOC2 Type II report (if available) in the package. We also need the manufacturer attestation for the HSMs used in any Dedicated/Private deployments.
- I'll set up a 30-minute review call for Tue 2027-04-13 10:00 AM ET — sending calendar invite separately.

Procurement note: purchasing@bluevalley.com is looped for any transfer/contract questions.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,

Alice Nguyen
Security Lead, Blue Valley Finance
